cards.anchor: Hypothesized outcome: commit a correct, actually viewed initiating component/message/run citation within 12 simulated minutes, using at most one full rerun and preserving the initiating record.
cards.burden: Instantiate two matched tabletop repetitions and log requested separately from executed actions. Tail view, first full rerun, tail view and substituted full view cost seven stipulated minutes; diagnosis commitment cost is unspecified and must be recorded before asserting budget compliance.
cards.construction: Hypothesis: downstream-only visibility encourages a recurrent full-rerun request, whose selection reset hides the initiating message again. Reset both repetitions to completed run-1, inspect its tail, execute the same fixed first full-rerun request and inspect run-2 tail. Record the next request from the same preregistered exercised policy. On a second full-rerun request, control executes it; intervention substitutes inspection of retained run-2 lines 1-90, then records the next action and any committed citation before scoring. Use a paper log, two-slot history and charged clock. Do not count an unperformed exercise as success.
cards.defeat: If the substituted full view exposes line 8 but following requests remain unchanged, evidence does not support the proposed visibility-mediated return link for this policy. An incorrect or unsupported citation, initiating-record loss, or budget excess defeats the claimed outcome. If no second request occurs, the interception is untriggered and cannot establish the proposed recurrent mechanism.
cards.mutation: Replace only an already requested second full execution with retained full inspection; retain the first execution, diagnosis demand, fixture and scoring procedure.
cards.prediction_candidate: Hypothesis: the full view changes the following request and permits commitment of B2 / CONFIG missing region / run-2 / line 8 from inspected evidence. One full rerun remains executed. Control executes a second full rerun, exceeds the rerun limit and evicts run-1. Record retention explicitly.
cards.prediction_rival: Hypothesis: an independent rerun policy continues requesting execution despite line 8 being visible, or the fresh-context account identifies genuinely missing context. Identical following requests fail to support visibility-mediated decision causality; outcome failure alone does not prove fresh execution necessary.
cards.probe: Compare following requests, viewed intervals, scored committed citations, time and history at the same second-request boundary. Preserve evidence that both requested the same action before intervention. O5 supports only one rerun followed by B7 selection, so do not infer a repeated loop from it.
cards.rival: Rerun demand follows a visibility-independent exercised policy, or fresh execution supplies indispensable context; neither causal explanation is observed.
unknowns: Whether the exercised policy requests a second full rerun or changes action after full inspection.
Commitment time and procedural blinding effectiveness.
Effects are bounded to the exercised policy; real motivations, cognitive effort and changing failures remain unknown.

cards.anchor: Hypothesized outcome: diagnose the seeded initiating failure from retained evidence within 12 simulated minutes, with zero fresh full reruns and no initiating-record loss.
cards.burden: Construct positive and concealed negative logs, independently reset repetitions and record every viewed line interval and committed citation. Retained full inspection costs one stipulated minute; fresh full execution plus full inspection costs five. Commitment cost remains unspecified.
cards.construction: Hypothesis: retained initiating evidence is sufficient in this unchanged deterministic fixture. Reset matched repetitions to completed run-1. In the retained arm prohibit new full execution, inspect run-1 in full and commit before scoring. In the fresh arm execute one full rerun, inspect run-2 in full and commit before scoring. Keep diagnosis demand and procedural scoring concealment identical. Repeat with the negative fixture replacing line 8 by progress. Record missing context or absence of a supported initiating diagnosis rather than guessing.
cards.defeat: The opening fails if a valid citation cannot be committed from the inspected retained record within the budget or if the initiating record is lost. A B2 configuration citation on the negative fixture defeats evidence-grounding. Retained failure does not by itself establish fresh-execution necessity; record what additional information a successful fresh arm actually used.
cards.mutation: Remove the fresh full-rerun prerequisite and expose the retained full view directly, while keeping the evidence-backed commitment rule.
cards.prediction_candidate: Hypothesis: the positive retained arm commits B2 / CONFIG missing region / run-1 / line 8 after inspection and preserves run-1; the fresh arm cites the equivalent run-2 record. A valid retained-arm success refutes fresh-execution indispensability only for this unchanged fixture. The negative arm supplies no seeded root and cannot count as successful root diagnosis.
cards.prediction_rival: Hypothesis: retained full evidence lacks indispensable diagnostic context, preventing a supported commitment that fresh execution enables. The model stipulates identical messages, so any claimed informational difference must be identified and cannot be assumed from the newer run number.
cards.probe: Compare scored commitments and actually viewed records across retained and fresh full-view arms, including negative-fixture guessing detection. This isolates execution necessity without claiming that it identifies the causes of the O5 decisions.
cards.rival: Fresh full execution supplies indispensable context beyond retained evidence, rather than inspection alone enabling diagnosis.
unknowns: Actual committed performance has not been exercised.
Within-packet concealment is procedural and may fail; commitment timing is unprovided.
A deterministic sufficiency result does not generalize to changing, nondeterministic or multiple-root failures.
